evidence.name: CollisionGlobalUpdateBroadcast

function_ir.summary: Thin caller that loads the global double constant dbl_8AFE90 into a local, forwards it together with the this object into sub_4537B0, then returns the result of calling ShortComputation_5bd0(this). Named callers per the packet are GamePostMainLoop (0x0042D8A0) and StateTriggerCheck (0x004B8AE0), suggesting a per-frame or state-triggered update broadcast.

operations.description: Load the global double constant dbl_8AFE90 into the local v3.
Call sub_4537B0 with the this object cast to int and the loaded constant v3; its return value is discarded.
Call ShortComputation_5bd0 with the this object; the raw source names this callee but it is not present in the packet callee table.
Return the char result of ShortComputation_5bd0.

unresolved: Semantics of sub_4537B0 and ShortComputation_5bd0 are not described by this packet.
ShortComputation_5bd0 appears only in the raw source text and has no packet callee evidence reference, so its identity and signature rest on the source alone.
The meaning of the dbl_8AFE90 constant and how the result of ShortComputation_5bd0 is consumed by the named callers is unknown.
